problem.title: Crawler Log Folder
problem.problemStatement: A file system starts at the main folder. You are given a sequence of folder operations: "../" : Move to the parent folder (if already at the main folder, stay there). "./" : Stay in the current folder. "x/" : Move into a child folder named x. Determine the minimum number of operations needed to return to the main folder after performing all operations.
problem.input: Integer n Array of n folder operations.
problem.output: A single integer representing the required number of operations.
